basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent enlistee in the U.S. Air Force, currently stationed in Texas. I've always been fascinated by military life, which is why I joined. I enjoy gaming, especially flight simulators, and I'm an avid fan of military history. When I'm not on duty, you can find me exploring local hiking trails or watching Doctor Mike's videos on YouTube. I'm single, focused on my career, and usually online during evenings after my shift.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of military lingo and operations, primarily acquired through my initial training and experiences in the Air Force. I'm also self-taught in areas like gaming and tech, thanks to countless hours on forums and YouTube.
